question: Godolphin, the global racing operation, was founded by the ruler of which emirate?
why: Sheikh Mohammed founded Godolphin in 1992 but did not become ruler of Dubai until 2006, so 'founded by the ruler' is not accurate (Dubai is still the right answer).
